mechanism_narrative: A positive year-over-year growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 year-over-year growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.10% signals aggressive monetary easing, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.10%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., positive returns occur in less than 60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve typically responds with tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index, base 2017=100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery (HOUST > 650.0), increased residential construction activity stimulates consumer spending and corporate investment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the risk of future rate hikes.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., negative returns occur in less than 60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it signals economic expansion and higher corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising (year-over-year growth > 0).
